scope: Execution reliability; approved R3 visuals preserved

environment.browser: Chromium with Playwright, in-memory workflow harness
environment.transport: session-backed HTTP bridge to real loopback app server
environment.providers: four deterministic local HTTP fixtures; no real vendor accounts or paid requests

full_regression.note: One existing optional media test skipped; passing tests do not certify all real-provider configurations.

browser_http.not_claimed: No direct localhost browser navigation, Windows recording, WebGL validation or real provider intelligence evaluation.

critical_observed_results: A HTTP401 -> B answers the same founder request; A stays runtime-unverified.
The same project proceeds through analysis, Council specification and worker execution after repeated calls and a UI reload.
Owner approval retained; T1 and dependent T2 complete, actual B worker/C reviewer metadata, real Git merge and inspected HTML files.
Mid-task A writes once then fails; B sees host ledger and same worktree; no automatic duplicate write.
Failed founder retry uses the existing user message ID.
Missing Radar card returns 422 before creating a phantom project/run.
Configured RSS evidence absent -> explicit limitation, no fabricated current gold news and no AI inference.
Workflow retry preserves completed operation receipts; uncertain publishing cannot be replayed automatically.
not_tested: Real Windows installation and vendor CLIs
Customer AI accounts and live quota/API billing behavior
known_boundaries: Unknown/authentication-identity/policy/permission/specification changes may require owner correction rather than fallback.
Fallback calls are bounded; all eligible accounts failing ends with explicit error, not infinite retry.
Native text inference handoff is not automatic replay of external shell engines or uncertain side effects.
RSS evidence is configured-source retrieval, not unrestricted general Internet search.
The local app must remain running for its execution; checkpoints do not add background compute.
assessment: R4 source implementation and isolated runtime acceptance passed; external Windows/live-account gates remain not_tested.
